intro: StorageCafe has no city statistics page for Fairbanks. UnitSight's September 2026 street-rate index, from 6 facilities and 78 listings, puts the standard 10x10 at $168. Climate-controlled rates were not published. StorageUnitCosts and Storage Stats do not publish this city, so the advertised rate is that UnitSight figure. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (UnitSight standard street rates). No StorageCafe industry-statistics page; climate-controlled rates not published; no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page.
